limitations: Platform adaptive aggregates do not disclose an effective sample count; no statistical significance claim is made.
Memory is a shared-isolate percentile; no per-request peak, leak-freedom, maximum-memory, or cold-isolate conclusion follows.
Initial and delayed collector outputs are separate observations of the same fixed windows; no favorable phase is selected automatically.
Large/history count-one cells are qualifications, not the ordinary high-sample comparison.
Source summary client quantiles are retained; no request journal is read, and request quantiles are not reconstructed or pooled.
No paid provider/native-client, soak, cancellation, reconnect, nonempty dump/R2, or recovery acceptance is established.
